description: Exempts installation of the Sprintex Supercharger System (S5-210 screw-type compressor with 69mm pulley, intake manifold, bypass valve, intercooler, wire harness extensions, intake tube, and reflashed ECM limiting boost to 12 psi) on the listed Subaru/Toyota coupes.
notes: 3-page document; page 2 signature date has a minor OCR artifact ('7tit'/'7th') but is legibly '7th day of August 2020'. Exhibit A literally lists Make='Toyota' / Model='Scion FR-S' for the 2012-2016 row (Scion was technically a separate marque); transcribed as printed. Device is itself a forced-induction (supercharger) kit for engines that are stock naturally-aspirated, but since Exhibit A does not mark an induction code (unlike other EOs' engine-description columns), the per-row induction field is left null rather than inferred; category is set to 'boost' to reflect the product type.
